name: rusalka

scripts.vendor: mkdir -p static/vendor/fonts && cp node_modules/verovio/dist/verovio-toolkit-wasm.js static/vendor/ && for v in 400 700 800; do for r in latin latin-ext; do cp node_modules/@fontsource/atkinson-hyperlegible-next/files/atkinson-hyperlegible-next-$r-$v-normal.woff2 static/vendor/fonts/; done; done && cp node_modules/@fontsource/atkinson-hyperlegible-next/LICENSE static/vendor/fonts/OFL.txt
scripts.skill: cp static/lib/song.js static/lib/note_names.js static/lib/notation.js plugin/skills/rusalka-sheet-music/scripts/lib/ && node tools/format-js.mjs
scripts.web: npm run vendor && npm run song-list && npm run library && node tools/web.mjs

description: Rusalka – a piano trainer for kids in the browser: play songs from MusicXML or MIDI on a MIDI piano
author: Jiří Nečas
